items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The Brotherhood Crusade is a wonderful – Danny Bakewell is a wonderful young man.

ctx.x: Do you want to go back to any of the organizations, the Whitney Young award from the Urban League?

Oh my goodness. There are a lot of awards, all right? But I will tell you one thing. Just recently, I was honored by The Brotherhood Crusade. The Brotherhood Crusade, I have been with and known since they started, and I did one of the first fundraisers that they ever had. They gave me – they had an evening honoring Nancy Wilson a few weeks ago that was the most magnificent thing I’ve ever seen. Of all the honors and awards and dinners and all that, this one was absolutely magnificent. The pictures, when you…
In 1974 you had an album called All in Love is Fair and a huge billboard on Sunset Boulevard.
